headers.//: The TypeDoc dump in public/reference/<version>/ is 236 static pages with no canonical, no per-page description (all 236 read 'Documentation for bunqueue'), duplicate titles and a 93-word median: 74% of the crawlable surface, none of it worth indexing. Keep it crawlable and linkable for humans, out of the index for search. This also defuses the version-churn trap: when the path bumps to v2.9 there are no indexed URLs left behind to 404.

Per-page markdown twins exist for AI crawlers (llms.txt convention). noindex keeps them fetchable while stopping them from competing with the HTML page they mirror. llms.txt / llms-full.txt are .txt and stay indexable.
